name: KAI (KaiBot)
dof_breakdown: 115 total including 72 in the hands — 36 per hand (22 active, 14 compliant)
price_note: target price, mass production planned for late 2026
summary: The most articulated humanoid built to date by joint count — 115 degrees of freedom, 72 of them in the hands — wrapped in a tactile skin of about 18,000 sensors that registers forces down to 0.1 N. Kinetix aims it at retail, concierge and household work: loading a dishwasher, folding clothes, threading a needle.
